Bird flu cases confirmed in two Australian states

Bird flu, specifically the H5N1 strain, has been confirmed in two Australian states, South Australia and Western Australia. Testing has been intensified following the detection of cases in infected petrels. This development has led to increased surveillance and testing across the country.
